It was tiny and of the same colour as the roe on top of the maki so it was hard to discover if it had not been ……. crawling on the dish. I asked for the waitress right there immediately and they quickly removed the dish before I was able to take any picture or video as evidence.
I did not receive any apology nor explanation whatsoever afterwards. What’s more is that I was about to be due and I was really scared. They just gave me a 10% off without any single apology so me and my husband were disappointed at their manner of handling of the situation.
